title: San Jose Home Energy Rebates 2026: What SJCE Pays | HomePowerRebate
desc: San Jose home rebates in 2026: San Jose Clean Energy pays $3,000 for a heat pump water heater and $1,500 for a heat pump, plus panel, insulation and wiring add-ons.
lead: San Jose's electricity supplier, San Jose Clean Energy (SJCE), pays real cash rebates through its EcoHome program, with higher amounts for homes in Environmental Justice communities. The water heater amount includes a $500 bonus that ends October 31, 2026. We read SJCE's page on October 1, 2026.
cards_intro: Each card links to a page with the rules and the local detail. SJCE rebates must be approved before you install, and every add-on needs a heat pump HVAC or water heater on the same project.

cards.title: Heat pump water heater
cards.note: $4,000 in EJ communities. Includes a $500 bonus until October 31, 2026.

cards.title: Heat pump HVAC
cards.note: $2,500 in EJ communities. Replaces a gas system.

cards.title: Attic insulation
cards.note: Up to $700, or $1,000 in EJ communities. With a heat pump HVAC.

cards.title: Panel and circuit add-ons
cards.note: Panel $1,000, EV, dryer or cooking circuit $500 each, pauser $250.

sections: SJCE pays more to households in Environmental Justice communities: $4,000 for a water heater, $2,500 for a heat pump HVAC, $2,000 for a panel upgrade and $750 for each prewiring circuit. You qualify if your home is in a highlighted area on SJCE's map and meets the income requirements, or if you are enrolled in CARE, FERA, SJ CARES or another income-based assistance program. Search your address on the map on the EcoHome page before you assume you do not.

You apply first, with a photo of your existing equipment and agreement to the Applicant Agreement. SJCE confirms by email in 2 to 4 business days, and approved funds are reserved for 120 days. Installation can begin only after approval, except for approved emergency replacements, which need an email to SJCEPrograms@smud.org first. Each residence gets one rebate per appliance type. SJCE's EcoHome Network and Go Electric Advisor help you plan, and its EcoHome Payment Plan can help with costs.
What is closed or not offered

SJCE's battery storage rebate, which paid $125 per kWh up to $3,250 ($400 per kWh up to $10,400 in an EJ community), no longer accepts new applications. We found no SJCE solar rebate. EcoHome pays no stand-alone insulation, EV charger or thermostat rebate: those appear only as add-ons to a heat pump project. If you find a current SJCE program we missed, tell us at hello@homepowerrebate.com.

The City of San Jose requires a plumbing permit for a water heater, and an electrical permit depending on the type, and it takes single-family and duplex permits online at SJPermits.org. See its water heater page and appliance installations page. San Jose's average January low over 2015 to 2024 was 6.7°C (about 44°F), with a coldest recorded day of -1.3°C.

BayREN's EASE Home program pays 80% of weatherization costs for income-qualified PG&E customers in Santa Clara County (BayREN). The federal 25C and 25D tax credits ended after December 31, 2025. TECH Clean California and the federal HEEHRA program for single-family homes are fully reserved and take new requests on hold only.

SJCE's $3,000 water heater rebate is above Burbank's $1,500 (Burbank) and Pasadena's $500 (Pasadena), and below Glendale's $4,000 (Glendale). Its heat pump rebate is a flat $1,500 where the Los Angeles-area utilities pay per ton.
installers_intro: These San Jose heat pump and HVAC companies have the best Google ratings, listed by rating and then review count. We are not paid to list anyone.
claim_steps: Confirm that you are a current SJCE customer, and look up your address on the Environmental Justice map.
Pick the upgrade that fits your next purchase and open its page for the rules.
Apply on the EcoHome Rebate page before installation, listing add-ons with the main equipment.
Wait for SJCE's confirmation email, then install within the 120 days of reserved funds.
Have your installer pull the City permit and finish the inspection.
Submit your claim with the paid invoice and permit.
faq: Who supplies electricity in San Jose?
San Jose Clean Energy supplies it, with PG&E delivering. SJCE's rebates are separate from PG&E's.
When does the water heater bonus end?
The $500 bonus applies to applications from September 1 to October 31, 2026.
Do I apply before or after installing?
Before. SJCE must approve the application first, and funds are held for 120 days.
No longer. SJCE's battery rebate is closed to new applications.
Can I get a rebate for insulation alone?
No. The attic insulation add-on must be paired with a heat pump HVAC rebate.
